title: HEERAMANDI UNPLUGGED
summary: A BLOCKBUSTER SPEAKER MEET — HEERAMANDI UNPLUGGED!
description:
A BLOCKBUSTER SPEAKER MEET — HEERAMANDI UNPLUGGED!
Our Speaker Meeting on 9 October 2026 at the Trident, Nariman Point, was a spectacular evening inspired by the world of Netflix’s Heeramandi.
We were delighted to welcome four wonderful speakers:

Moin Beg
Barnali Chattopadhyay
Raja Pandit
Dr. Khooshi Gurubhai Thakkar

They brought the magic of Heeramandi to life through conversation, song and entertainment, taking us behind the scenes of the series. Their fascinating insights revealed the creative process, the stories audiences rarely hear, and the hard work, dedication and long hours that go into creating a grand production.

With over 100 members and spouses in attendance, the Poolside Mexican Room was filled to the brim and buzzing with excitement. The warmth, camaraderie, entertainment and fellowship made it a truly memorable evening!
